FN-KOPB5A-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 377
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Kyle South
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/28/2023
House Bill 377 as introduced could decrease the administrative obligations of the Board of
Adjustment by allowing the board to approve uncontested claims on an expedited basis without
a full hearing.
Page 1

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 377
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Kyle South
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/30/2023
House Bill 377 as passed the House of Representatives could decrease the administrative
obligations of the Board of Adjustment by allowing the board to approve uncontested claims on
an expedited basis without a full hearing.
